policies.lowDiskSpace: Latest qualified system-drive evidence is Low when free space is below 20 GB or below 15 percent; missing capacity evidence remains Unknown.
policies.identityMatch: NotApplicable is excluded; unmatched and conflicting candidates remain in the denominator.
policies.deviceCompliance: Unknown compliance is excluded from the rate and remains visible as a separate state.
policies.windowsAdoption: Only Windows 10 and Windows 11 assessed devices are eligible.
policies.windowsReadiness: Only Windows 10 devices with Ready or Blocked results are eligible.
policies.secureScore: Only observations with qualified evidence contribute to numerator and maximum score.
policies.sourceFreshness: All required sources remain in the denominator; failed, partial, stale, and missing sources do not pass.
